notes.subject: koso min ma ban abada
notes.rationale: הרת עולם 'pregnancy of eternity': KJV/ASV 'always great with child', YLT 'age-during pregnancy', BSB 'forever enlarged' — rendered here literally as a pregnancy that never ends.

notes.subject: מרחם / רחמה
notes.rationale: womb appears twice in one verse, opening and closing it; the repetition frames Jeremiah's wish never to have left the womb.

notes.subject: sabu
notes.rationale: אשר read as causal 'because' (following the curse of v.16), rather than relative 'who'.

translation: Sabu a ma fɛn nin sa denyɛso kɔnɔ, ani n ba kɛra n yɔrɔbo ye, a denyɛso koso ma ban abada.
